No clear view of the model number/label (e.g., SE630) on the machine body or underside (photo 0 and photo 1).

claims.claim: Upgrade your sewing and embroidery projects with this Brother SE630 Computerized Sewing and...
claims.evidence: SE630 model number is not readable in photo 0 or photo 1; only the Brother logo is clearly visible.

risks.risk: Model mismatch: the machine may not be SE630 (could be another Brother computerized/embroidery model).
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the model label/nameplate (usually on the side/back/bottom) showing 'SE630' (or exact model).
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic Brother computerized sewing/embroidery machine (worst-case: not confirmed SE630).

risks.risk: Missing essential parts/accessories (power cable, foot pedal, bobbin case, embroidery hoops, presser feet, USB/cord, manual).
risks.proof: A photo laid out showing every included item, plus a close-up of the ports and where the foot pedal connects.
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete/unknown bundle (worst-case: buyer may need to source missing accessories).

risks.risk: Not working or intermittent faults (motor, screen, embroidery unit, stitch accuracy).
risks.proof: A short video of a full power-on + screen working, then a stitch test and (if embroidery) a short embroidery run.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not guaranteed working (worst-case: needs service).

risks.risk: Mechanical issues not visible in photos (needle bar alignment, feed dog problems, tension issues).
risks.proof: A photo/video of a completed test seam showing even stitches and correct tension (front and back of fabric).
risks.if_unproven: Price as requiring servicing/adjustment (worst-case: tension/feed issues).

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the machine’s model label/nameplate showing the exact model (SE630 or otherwise).
Photos of included accessories: foot pedal, power cable, bobbins/bobbin case, presser feet, embroidery hoops, and any USB/manual.
Video: power-on showing the touchscreen, then a short stitch test (and embroidery test if applicable).
Photo of the underside/side ports and the serial/model sticker.
response.reason: The photos confirm it’s a Brother computerized sewing/embroidery machine, but the exact SE630 model and working condition are not verifiable from the provided images. Without the model label and a test, pricing would be too risky.
